summary: New nether biomes don t work properly in buffet worlds
description: The bug The new nether biomes (nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest and basalt deltas) do not work in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce - Create New World - Select More World Options - Make a buffet world - Select Soul Sand Valley - Set terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode Freezes the game before it even loads terrain (Image Below) -Surface mode creates a purely ocean world (This happened the first time i tried to make one but works fine now for some reason) The following list is updated in version 20w15a: Biomes All world generators that freeze the game Nether wastes Surface Crimson forest Surface Warped forest Surface and floating islands Soul sand valley Surface Basalt deltas Surface
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new world.
2. Select "More World Options".
3. Choose "Buffet" as the world type.
4. Select "Soul Sand Valley" from the biome list.
5. Set the terrain type to either "Floating Islands" or "Surface Floating Island mode".
6. Attempt to load the newly created world.
7. Observe that the game freezes before loading any terrain.
8. Note if the freeze persists and take a screenshot for documentation.

1. Create a new world.
2. Select "More World Options".
3. Choose "Buffet" as the world type.
4. Select "Soul Sand Valley" from the biome list.
5. Set the terrain type to "Surface".
6. Attempt to load the newly created world.
7. Observe that the world generates as a purely ocean biome instead of the intended Soul Sand Valley.
8. Note this discrepancy and take a screenshot for documentation.

Observed Behavior: The new nether biomes—including Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, and Basalt Deltas—do not function properly in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce the issue, create a new world, select More World Options, choose to make a buffet world, and select Soul Sand Valley. Setting the terrain type to either Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode causes the game to freeze before it even loads the terrain. In Surface mode, a purely ocean world is created, although this behavior has been inconsistent, working correctly in some instances. The issue affects all mentioned biomes when set on the surface or floating islands: Nether Wastes, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Soul Sand Valley, and Basalt Deltas.
Expected Behavior: When creating a buffet world with new nether biomes like Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, or Basalt Deltas in Surface or Floating Island modes, the game should correctly generate the selected biome without freezing. The terrain should load properly, and players should be able to explore these nether biomes as intended in both surface and floating island configurations.
